correctness.rationale: The asserted spectrum is correct as a multiset indexed by isotypic blocks: d_j^2 is the contribution from block j, not the global multiplicity of a scalar shared by several blocks (notably zero). With normalized area the addition kernel after scaling is U_l(Re(g^-1 h))/(l+1). Character orthogonality diagonalizes this central kernel, and Clebsch–Gordan gives the stated affine E8 recurrence. Central parity cuts the regular representation to 60 dimensions; noncentral angles of denominators 2, 3 and 5 give the exact sixty-step shift after taking inner products, and vanishing of all noncentral kernel entries is equivalent to l+1 being divisible by 30. The independent recurrence gives ranks 59 and 60 at degrees 58 and 59 and the first full ranks at odd 13 and even 20; the shift proves full rank at every degree >=60, not merely within the checked range.
residual_risks: Floating-point agreement samples finitely many degrees; the all-degree argument is character-theoretic. The source's multiplicity wording should be read blockwise as in its proof.
